divisions.headline: Rally races to huge win over tough Niners squad, can almost clinch with a wk11 win; Knights win, lock in on 2nd alone when the Bandits take out Sanchez to drop them 2 behind

picks.text: Point & Rally @ Dart Knights. Rally is one of the five undefeated teams still left, and there is only one team within any reach of them: their recent competitive rivals, the Knights. Well, here we are. Not sure if there is time for the Knights to make up the point deficit too, but a win here pulls them within one match. The Knights' problem is that they keep starting behind in 301. So this is Rally, 14-10.

divisions.headline: Cheap Shots, Death Throw, & Down to F all handle business, finally separating themselves from the tight pack a bit

picks.text: Down to F, Again @ Death Throw. F division was an anyone-can-win-it situation for a VERY long time, but we are finally starting to get a little clarity. It looks like the race is really down to three teams, these two and the Cheapies. This isn't exactly an elimination match, but it's close. Huge night. Down to F takes a 1001.
That's What She Said @ Nein Mark. We're getting to the point where we start defining the bottom-two in F. It's pretty much a four-team battle. Dillon leads a She Said win, 13-11.
picks.call: Dillon leads a She Said win, 13-11.

divisions.headline: We Throw It jumps all over division leader Banging, closing them out before 501; Rippin drops 8 cricket points, needs a 1001 to outlast winless Wayward, and now control their own title fate again; Machine sweeps two sets, now back in the race

picks.text: Sharky's Machine @ Banging the Wire. Wow, did the G race get a jolt last week when Banging went down. Suddenly, 5 of the 7 G teams are within 2 losses of 1st! Machine is on a 3-match run and could pull within 1 with a win. Alas, I think it's Banging, 13-11.
Aim-ing For Trouble @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. G has become an awesome situation where teams could still fall to H or climb to F. Awesome parity. Throw It gets payback, 13-11.
Flight Club 14, Cary On Our Wayward Darts 10
